title: WARNING RED ENEMY TRACERS
why: His g-88 answer: Enemy tracers in a warning colour. Hostile machines and pillager bots fire #ff3b2f rounds in both windows. Player, hire and friendly rounds retain gun colours, including player forge elements and widths. Muzzle flashes stay warm. Render only; no seeded draw or text changes. Watch in play: red enemy rounds must stand out from the red danger HUD, red noise rings and attack lanes, at night and in rain. Two hostile pillager crews fighting each other must still read.
now: Enemy rounds warn in red in both windows; allied rounds keep their gun colours.
